verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an LLM tracing platform, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions images, audio, file attachments or media handling in traces. The docs only describe capturing prompts, responses, token usage, latency, and tool or retrieval steps.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
